page_title: VER 1-0 UDI | Verona v Udinese 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 1 - 0 Ondrej Duda takes the corner and Diego Coppola (Verona) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
90+3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner.
90+2' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Lucca departs the field of play to be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it.
87' Walace (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Verona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
84' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
83' Substitution. Ondrej Duda (Verona) has come on for Suat Serdar.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juan Cabal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
82' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
81' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue is replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Vinagre (Verona) will replace Darko Lazovic.

76' Suat Serdar (Verona) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the bottom left corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Maduka Okoye and his brilliant save.
75' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) behaves unsportingly.
74' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Jaka Bijol (Udinese), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
74' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
73' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
72' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

71' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Tijjani Noslin (Verona) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye keeps it out with an amazing save.
70' Darko Lazovic (Verona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
69' An attempted cross from Fabien Centonze (Verona) is cleared.
68' Darko Lazovic (Verona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
68' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
65' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Juan Cabal (Verona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.
64' A goal, which was scored by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese), was disallowed due to offside.
63' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
63' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
62' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Udinese get a corner.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Roberto Pereyra (Udinese). The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
59' Here is a change. Daniel Silva is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
59' The substitution has been made. Karol Swiderski (Verona) has replaced Stefan Mitrovic.
58' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
55' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
55' Darko Lazovic (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Verona win a corner kick.
52' A dangerous towering header by Jaka Bijol (Udinese) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
52' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will take the corner.

51' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
49' Lazar Samardzic sprays a pass out to Jaka Bijol (Udinese), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
48' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
47' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Darko Lazovic (Verona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Marco Guida blows the whistle, Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Verona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The linesman raises his flag. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
45' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header from near the penalty spot crashes against the right post! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
44' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
43' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a precise pass into the box, but Tijjani Noslin loses the one-on-one with the defender.
43' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) meets a cross inside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

42' Fabien Centonze (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle. Udinese earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
42' Udinese players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.

38' A big rebound falls at the feet of Daniel Silva (Verona). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.

38' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. It's a throw-in for Verona.
36' 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
33' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the free kick with a stunning missile of a shot, but it goes just wide of the left post!
32' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is always a threat to goalkeepers from set pieces and he will take the long-range free kick.
30' Fabien Centonze (Verona) is caught offside!
29' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
26' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Udinese earn a corner.
24' Darko Lazovic (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
22' A dangerous towering header by Juan Cabal (Verona) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
22' Darko Lazovic (Verona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
20' Udinese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
18' A pass by Juan Cabal (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
16' It's like he was asking for a caution. Walace (Udinese) receives a yellow card.
14' Juan Cabal (Verona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
13' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Suat Serdar (Verona) gets booked.
11' The Verona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Diego Coppola (Verona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
8' Darko Lazovic (Verona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
7' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
6' Martin Payero (Udinese) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
5' Diego Coppola (Verona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Udinese.

3' Walace (Udinese) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
